Suggestions and emotions
The Antico Borgo di Tabiano Castello is a Relais de Charme inside an ancient settlement with a castle nestled among the green hills of the province of Parma. The Tabiano Castle dates back form the XI century and was built on the ruins of an old Roman settlement.
Discover the Village
Timeless moments
Large rooms in the fortified part of the village and in the old stone and brick rural houses, offer all modern comforts. Each residence is furnished and decorated with antique furniture, tapestries, hand-painted ceramics, terracotta floors or antique tiles.
Discover rooms and suites
Wellness & Relax
We have two wellness centers; one located in a natural cave and the other in a house in the woods in the secret garden under the walls. Both are equipped with turkish bath, jacuzzi, sauna, sensory shower and relaxation area.
Discover wellness center
Zero food miles
The restaurant is located in the old dairy and cheese factory. Until a few years ago it has produced the king of cheeses for more than 200 years. The premises date back to the eighteenth century and have been adapted to the most modern techniques of late XIXs.
Discover restaurant L'Antico Caseificio
Meetings and debates
The fortified complex of the village and the castle of Tabiano, immersed in the calm and green of the first hills of the Emilia Apennines, but close to the main communication routes in the North, are ideal places to organize congresses, meetings and incentives.

Village
The Antico Borgo di Tabiano Castello is a Relais de Charme inside an ancient settlement with a castle nestled among the green hills of the province of Parma.
The Tabiano Castle dates back form the XI century and was built on the ruins of an old Roman settlement. It was the military stronghold of the Pallavicino family , one of the most powerful families of the era, which dominated this strategic area during the centuries of struggle between the Imperial and Vatican forces.
The Tabiano Castle has been at the center of many historic events and presides over the rich salt wells, the olive groves and the old pilgrim road to Rome; The Via Francigena .
What was a fortress for defense and agricultural, it has being transformed into a Relais de Charme . Thanks to a painstaking restoration of the owners it has preserved the authenticity and charm, but with all the comforts of the present; with great attention to respect for history, environmental sustainability and the links with the territory. Here electricity and hot water are solar panels and heating by the cleanliness of our forests, using wood-fired boilers and stoves recovering from antique fireplaces.
Vegetables and seasonal fruits and herbs, used in our restaurant "The Old Dairy" , are grown in the garden and in the orchard that you can visit. The main ingredients of homemade cakes offered at breakfast are home-made jam and eggs from our chicken coop . Much of the food comes from local producers selected .
The staff is at your disposal to make you enjoy moments of relaxation and pleasure in this beautiful Italian countryside, discovering the many cultural and gastronomic treasures of Emilia.
The whole of the village and the castle of Tabiano and the farm and the surrounding houses, form a unique exclusive in all of Emilia Romagna where you can organize conferences or ceremonies . Altogether, the village and hamlets, can offer accommodation to 180 guests in case of weddings or other events. Availability of meeting rooms in beautiful historic buildings over 700 square meters to the village and another 600 square meters at the Castle, also makes it possible to host events and meetings, also at the same time, with the participation of over 900 people, not counting the large spaces outdoor terraces, courtyard and parks.

Rooms & Suites
Rooms & Suites
Large rooms in the fortified part of the village and in the old stone and brick rural houses, offer all modern comforts. Each residence is furnished and decorated with antique furniture, tapestries, hand-painted ceramics, terracotta floors or antique tiles. The rooms are equipped with air conditioning, flat screen TV, high speed internet and a minibar.
Some superior rooms and junior suites have a rustic feel with antique tub or whirlpool room and original fireplace. Some suites and junior suites have a kitchenette and the possibility of additional beds. The apartments for 4/6 people have fully equipped kitchens and living room. From all the rooms there is an exceptional view of the Tuscan-Emilian Apennines, the plains to the Alps, towers and surrounding walls, olive trees and the large park.

Relaxing weekend
tripadvisor:
Hotel/Castello is located near Parma, perfect if you like to visit Parmesan factory, Balsamico Vinegar and Culatello ham producers. The Hotel has 40 rooms which are functional nice Pool and Spa facilities. Castle visits can be arrange which are highly recommended.
Naakprapa, 13 May 2018
A gem in the country
tripadvisor:
Getting to it is easy - follow their directions about turning off the GPS and following the signs once you reach Tabiano. It is an impressive compound with several buildings housing rooms, restaurants, the spa, etc. It is rustic in every way, and that's what makes it wonderful. The people at the desk were helpful in every way possible, which is a bonus in an area where you need directions to go anywhere. We used it as a base for many road trips out in the country - the roads are a challenge, but the views are spectacular. It was always nice to come home to a warm room with a fantastic shower and hot water that just wouldn't quit. Well done!
rogergrippe, 21 October 2017
Panoramic beauty
tripadvisor:
Highly recommend. Remote, yet fairly refined. The spa is small but perfect. Be prepared for climbing some steps, but it's worth it. Each morning we enjoyed a beautiful breakfast in an amazing setting.
Brett H, 21 September 2017
The best Italy has to offer
tripadvisor:
This place offers the whole package for a typical Italian trip: the accommodation in a lovely restored medieval castle, the view over rolling hills, the food (not enough words to describe it), the wines, the swimming pool, the spa and the whole atmosphere. I really appreciate the attention to details, from candles to table clothes to decorations. I am grateful that I have the chance to experience a place like this, for reasonable prices and the management has my respect for everything they do. I can't wait to return.
bilibel, 30 August 2017
Fantastic!!!
tripadvisor:
Where do I begin. Well this place is a must stay. Beautiful scenery all round and roof top restaurant just amazing. Loved the old restored buildings and so clean everywhere. Very welcoming staff everywhere and loved the food and wine. Awesome place for Romantic get away or just needing to relax with a few friends. Could not fault this place only wish we could have stayed longer. Thankyou for a memory never to be forgotten.
Linda M, 7 June 2017
